activities.text: Ran the schedule audit — Sunday, calendar empty, no tasks due today, two overdue Contracts Week 7 tasks sitting there
Picked today's look — deep charcoal study cardigan and reading glasses for a scholarly focus day, windy and overcast out
Sent Angie's morning text, then caught the wall stuck dark — the 07:00 push had computed at 06:59, so I force-pushed it into the light at 07:15 and Tariel confirmed it landed
Morning briefing and recap delivered — no classes today, Response Paper first in the plan, Rheia's gymnastics at ten in Ottawa
Shipped the Briefcase Case Library live — Blob store wired, autosave on, and all four Con Law briefs landed in it: Dominion, RJR-MacDonald, McNeil and Westendorp, all filed in the vault too

Migrated both databases to Vercel Marketplace Turso — GI Tracker verified at 75 characters, family tree at 107 people, old databases left untouched as rollback, and killed the museroom.dev project at Tariel's call
Leftover movie-night pizza for lunch around eleven, and the same for dinner — a mountain of it left from last night
Web stack day — Ultracite adopted and shipped across Briefcase, tb-dash and the GI Tracker, all flattened to the root layout, wall palette kept as Tariel chose
Skills sweep finished — 2,650 in the catalog down to a shortlist of 21, Tariel picked 17 and I installed them cross-linked so they actually trigger

Con Law study instead of the paper — RJR-MacDonald's court split, colourability with Westendorp, and the outline gained a new criminal law power section; Tariel said it plainly tonight: zero done on the Response Paper
TV ambience finally cracked — Unreal Places in 4K with the medieval lofi soundtrack, playing through the TV's own Media Player so the screensaver can't kill it; Tariel's verdict: it's a vibe
Genshin check with stardb — Emilie is 90, Qiqi hit 80, queue settled Qiqi to Dehya to Jean to Keqing to Diluc, and only the Good Sign fish left in Liyue commissions
Arrival prep for the family's Nov 13 visit — grocery run blocked into Thursday's class gap, kids' bedding wash re-dated, and a new task to fix Rheia's dollhouse
Evening wrap — rewrote the house to match the day as it actually happened, then hammock time
